note: Single source for the release bundles. Cargo default features are always on; `features` are added to them.

default.title: Default
default.summary: Compare, prove, review, perf and arms evidence, MCP server, workbench. Nothing to provision.

media.title: Media
media.summary: Default plus C2PA credentials, PDF/SVG documents, imgtune/product tools and Rust OCR. OCR models and the ONNX runtime are provisioned with `saccade models pull`.

full.title: Full
full.summary: Media plus embeddings, geometry, dense motion, local models and providers, assist and media HTTP.

excluded_everywhere.imgtune-avif: Links libdav1d dynamically through pkg-config; a prebuilt binary would need that library on the user's machine. Build from source with `cargo install saccade --features imgtune-avif`.
